opener_concept: Skateboard/gamer '180' and '360' turns: a 180 faces you the opposite way (half turn = 180 degrees), a 360 brings you back to start (full turn = 360 degrees). Two angles on a straight line share that 180 degree half-turn, which is exactly the elimination-free common-sense move behind every angle fact in the lesson.
